generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

Estimate rates are excluding GST as per Common SR 2023-24 continued to 2024-25 and prevailing GST (18% of Amount Put to tender) amount is kept in the form of Lump sum in sanctioned estimate according to guidelines in Common SR 2023-24 (As per the circular from Govt of Karnataka no.12/2024 Bengaluru dt:09.08.2024). Therefore, Amount put to Tender and ECV amounts are excluding GST even though it is showing inclusive Tax in Draft Tender Schedule Process. Hence, GST will be paid separately for the quoted amount accordingly. The bidder has to quote the rate exclusive of GST and to submit a declaration which is duly signed by the bidder along with their tender proposal.
The contractor shall submit the details of technical staff employed by him.
The employer reserves the rights to reject one or all tenders without assigning any reason.
The employer is not responsible for any delay in accessing E- procurement portal.
Contractors should be registered with KPWD Class - III and above Registration and the tenderer should submit the Registration Certificate along with technical bid.
To qualify for award of this contract, each tenderer should give all details and documents as per Technical and Financial bid attached to this tender.
All the formats prescribed in the bid document shall be filled by the tenderer in complete manner otherwise it will be rejected.

All the scanned documents pertaining to bidder to be uploaded shall be in original and same originals should be produced to the Executive Engineer (at the time of Technical Bid Opening) who reserves right to verify the original documents before approval.
Contractors should follow strictly prevailing rules of labour act.

The Item rates quoted shall include cost of Royalty charges on construction materials and other taxes as per rates provided in prevailing Govt orders at the time of execution and including cost and conveyance of all materials curing, loading and unloading with all lead and lifts, labour, hire charges of machineries and equipment etc., complete and all other incidental charges. All the items shall be executed as directed by the Engineer-in-charge of the work.

All materials required for this work shall be procured by the bidder himself and should be got tested by the quality control authorities at his own cost before use on the work. Department will not supply any materials.

Materials like bitumen, steel,cement etc., required for the work shall be procured by the tenderer themselves and should get tested by the quality control authority at his cost before used on the work.

All documents should be uploaded by the contractor is to be attested by the authorized notary or not below the rank of Executive Engineer and should be produced for verification at any stage of process as and when sought for .Failure to produce original documents leads to rejection of Tender.
Units, Rates and Prices shall be quoted by the tender in Indian Rupees only
The contractor should maintain the work during the defective liability period, i.e. UP TO 01 year at his own cost
Contractors should have Registration of GST, Employers Provident Fund and tenderer should submit Registration Certificate along with technical bid.
Payment of EMD of Rs. 50,100.00 shall be through E payment

The successful bidder has to follow the prevailing Government orders regarding Royalty Charges. The Contractor has to submit MDP Certificate along with the running contractor bills. Otherwise Department will take necessary action as per the Government Orders/Circulars.

For maintenance type of work the contractor should maintain the road for one year from the date of agreement & for constructive work the contractor should maintain the work during its defective liability period

itemList.description: Clearing  &  grubbing  road  land  including  vegetation,  bushes, shrubs, saplings by using weed cutter / minor equipment. ---- Including cost and conveyance of all materials, labour, hire charges of machinery and equipment with all lead and lifts, loading and unloading charges, etc., complete as directed as per specification and direction of the engineer in charge of the work.

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -16- PANCHAYATH RAJ ENGINEERING DEPARTMENT ITEMS
itemList.description: Maintenance of Drains - The maintenance of drains include erosion, repair, clearing, cleaning,  reshaping,  regrading,  deepening  of  side  drains as well as catch water drains as per technical specification Clause 1908. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 1908 ---- Including cost and conveyance of all materials, labour, hire charges of machinery and equipment with all lead and lifts, loading and unloading charges, etc., complete as directed as per specification and direction of the engineer in charge of the work.

Maintenance of Earthen Shoulder (filling with fresh soil) - Making  up  loss  of  material/  irregularities  on  shoulder  to  the design level by adding fresh approved soil and compacting it with appropriate equipment.Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 3003 ---- Including cost and conveyance of all materials, labour, hire charges of machinery and equipment with all lead and lifts, loading and unloading charges, etc., complete as directed as per specification and direction of the engineer in charge of the work.

Maintenance of Earth Shoulder (stripping excess soil) - Stripping excess soil from the shoulder surface to achieve the approved level and compacting with plate compactor. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 3003 ---- Including cost and conveyance of all materials, labour, hire charges of machinery and equipment with all lead and lifts, loading and unloading charges, etc., complete as directed as per specification and direction of the engineer in charge of the work.

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -16- PANCHAYATH RAJ ENGINEERING DEPARTMENT ITEMS
itemList.description: White  washing  of  parapet  walls  of  CD  work  and  tree trunks - White washing two coats on parapet walls and tree trunks including preparation of surface by cleaning scraping etc. as per technical specifications. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 1916 ---- Including cost and conveyance of all materials, labour, hire charges of machinery and equipment with all lead and lifts, loading and unloading charges, etc., complete as directed as per specification and direction of the engineer in charge of the work.

Patching of Potholes - Patching of Shallow Potholes using SDBC Gr II 25 mm thick - Patching  of  shallow  potholes  on  asphalt  surfaces  by  using Semi Dense Bituminous Concrete 25mm thickness. The Cost is inclusive of removing the failed materials & cleaning on the road surface, preparation of potholes to the required standards sizes before patching them and application of tack coat at 0.20 kg/ m2 over the asphalt surface including lead, loading unloading, rolling and finishing etc., complete as per specification. ---- Including cost and conveyance of all materials, labour, hire charges of machinery and equipment with all lead and lifts, loading and unloading charges, etc., complete as directed as per specification and direction of the engineer in charge of the work.

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -4- SUB-BASES, BASES (NON-BITUMINOUS), SHOULDERS AND STABILIZATION METHODS
itemList.description: Wet Mix Macadam (Plant Mix Method) - Providing,   laying,   spreading   and   compacting   graded   stone aggregate to wet mix macadam specification including premixing the Material with water at OMC in mechanical mix plant carriage of mixed Material by tipper to site, laying in uniform layers with paver/grader in sub-base / base course on well prepared surface and compacting with vibratory rollerto achieve the desireddensity. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 406 ---- Including cost and conveyance of all materials, labour, hire charges of machinery and equipment with all lead and lifts, loading and unloading charges, etc., complete as directed as per specification and direction of the engineer in charge of the work.

Prime Coat over WMM/WBM - Providing  and  applying  primer  coat  with  SS1  grade  Bitumen Emulsion   on   prepared   surface   of   granular   base   including cleaning of road surface and spraying primer at the rate of 0.70 kg/m2  using mechanical means. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 502 ---- Including cost and conveyance of all materials, labour, hire charges of machinery and equipment with all lead and lifts, loading and unloading charges, etc., complete as directed as per specification and direction of the engineer in charge of the work.

Dense Graded Bituminous  Macadam Grading -  II for traffic <20 MSA - Providing  and  laying  Dense  Graded  Bituminous  Macadam  with 100 TPH capacity HMP batch type using crushed aggregates of specified  grading,  premixed  with  bituminous  binder  VG-30,  @ 4.5  per  cent   by  weight  of  total  mix  and  filler,  transporting  the hot  mix  to  work  site,  laying  with  mechanical  paver  finisher  to the  required  grade,  level  and  alignment,  rolling  with  smooth wheeled,  vibratory  and  tandem  rollers  to  achieve  the  desired compaction as per MoRTH specification clause No. 505 complete in all respects. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 505 ---- Including cost and conveyance of all materials, labour, hire charges of machinery and equipment with all lead and lifts, loading and unloading charges, etc., complete as directed as per specification and direction of the engineer in charge of the work.

Bituminous Concrete Grading II for traffic <20 MSA - Providing   and   laying   Bituminous   Concrete   with   100   TPH capacity  hot  mix  plant  batch  type  using  crushed   aggregates  of specified  grading,  premixed  with  bituminous  binder  VG-30,  @5.4 per cent   of mix and filler, transporting the hot mix to work site, laying with mechanical paver finisher to the required grade, level and alignment, rolling with smooth wheeled, vibratory and tandem rollers to achieve the desired compaction as per MORTH specification clause No. 507 complete in all respects. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 507 ---- Including cost and conveyance of all materials, labour, hire charges of machinery and equipment with all lead and lifts, loading and unloading charges, etc., complete as directed as per specification and direction of the engineer in charge of the work.

Patching of Deep Potholes using WBM GrI and SDBC GrII 25mm Thick: Patching of Deep Potholes 75mm thick by restoring the Granular Base course using material confirming to WBM Grade -II with typeB Screenings standards wherever necessary by manual means including trimming the pothole to the required shape and size, cleaning the pothole, applying Prime Coat (SS1) at 0.70 kg per m2 over the WBM surface and covering the surface with SDBC 25mm thick including lead, loading unloading, rolling and finishing etc., complete as per specification. ---- Including cost and conveyance of all materials, labour, hire charges of machinery and equipment with all lead and lifts, loading and unloading charges, etc., complete as directed as per specification and direction of the engineer in charge of the work.
